secondary.extraction: Reference year only, unchanged source rows and vector IDs

definitions.DHEA: Household disposable income equivalised using OECD-modified units (1/.5/.3), household-weighted quintiles; HFCE excluding social transfers in kind.
definitions.SHS: Household total before-tax income, not equivalised; current consumption.

gate_protocol.G1: Positive cash-income households; realized zero goods at t0 and each quarter strictly <2%.
gate_protocol.G2: Accounting <=1e-8; Q4-Q12 constrained-share OLS <=.25 pp/q; Q12 saving [-5.6,4.4]%; Q1 consumption >=95% target.
gate_protocol.G3: DHEA shares primary, relative deviation <=15% in every quintile at t0 and every quarter; SHS secondary only. No distributional rescale.
gate_protocol.G4: Q12 C and GDP within5% of same-seed accepted FE arm F, e386f4e lineage.

kappa: User-approved unestimated assumptions: .01/q base, .005/.02/q sensitivities; asymmetric above .005 and below .02. Smoothing .25.
mapping_limits: Model cash DI omits SNA noncash income components; source household-member skeleton retained. OECD equivalence is applied without reweighting. SHS gross-income rank reconstructed from modeled net components/tax rates. Noncash owner housing consumption is not separately tagged inside L; subtracting the rent_imputed memo would not be an exact bridge. Expected owner-imputed-rent bias raises upper-quintile SHS-comparison shares.
